create_RopeKVCacheFusionPass: create a RopeKVCacheFusionPass from a VllmConfig to fuse RoPE and KV cache operations in the compilation pipeline
run_RopeReshapeKVCachePattern: run a RopeReshapeKVCachePattern on an fx.Graph to match and replace unfused RoPE and kv cache update ops with a fused op
register_RopeReshapeKVCachePattern: register a RopeReshapeKVCachePattern with a PatternMatcherPass for a given Attention layer and is_neox setting
test_RopeKVCacheFusionPass_applicability: test whether a RopeKVCacheFusionPass is applicable for a given compile Range based on max token count
build_custom_op_fused_rope: build a custom torch op fused_rope_and_unified_kv_cache_update that fuses rotary embedding and KV cache update into a single kernel
